prerequisites: Second year subjects of the Common to the Industrial Branch module

learning_outcomes.text: Apply the discipline to the field of industrial organization.

Understand the fundamentals of different intelligent data analysis methods and the types of results or knowledge they produce, enabling the selection of the most appropriate option for each real case study.
Know how to apply metaheuristic techniques used in intelligent data processing.
Prepare reports with the results of the data mining process.

assessment_rules: In the ordinary call, the theoretical block (TEO = 0.2 * TEO1 + 0.8 * TEO2) and practical block (PRA = 0.5 * PRA1 + 0.5 * PRA2) each require a minimum score of 4 out of 10. If these minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as 0.5 * TEO + 0.4 * PRA + 0.1 * PTG; otherwise, the final grade is the minimum between the calculated score and 4.0. In the extraordinary call, a theoretical exam and a practical exam are taken, each requiring a minimum of 4 out of 10. If these minimums are met, the final grade is 0.5 * TEO + 0.5 * PRA. If more than 50% of activities are not completed, the final grade will be "No Presentado".
